$Comment: What the Yeti's Boss Kill Claim (Rewards/Christmas/Christmas_Yeti_Chase) pays, for the first win each
day. Every roll is read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays and the Claim is never
empty; the next two are the chances at his fur, the Yeti Fur Hood (about 1 in 6) and the Yeti Fur
Coat (1 in 10), warm heavy leather that keeps out the cold. The Claim is not scaled by each
player's share of the fight, so everyone who fought him rolls these odds. The Almanac's Christmas
grid lists what this table pays, so change them together. Mmo_Christmas_Yeti_Chase.json adds Defense
XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. A companion mod adds rolls with a
file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Christmas_Yeti_Chase
